entries.source: WO-0004 builder round 3 (coordinator follow-ups after the v1.1.1 merge)
entries.finding: version-surfaces: a ?v= token is counted wherever it appears once comments are stripped - HTML text, a plain JS string, or a comment inside an inline <script> in index.html - so one of those beside a REMOVED real token keeps the count at 16 and the gate passes
entries.fixed: release/v1.2.0 (commit recorded in WO-0004 builder round 3): only src=/href= attribute values (Vue :src/:href included) are cache tokens; inline <script> bodies in index.html are dropped before the scan; test: t41 reg0014-only-src-and-href-attribute-values-are-cache-tokens

entries.source: WO-0004 builder round 3 (coordinator follow-ups after the v1.1.1 merge)
entries.finding: tests/run.sh cannot tell when a test file stops early: an exit 0 after its first case passed as a file with fewer cases
entries.fixed: release/v1.2.0 (commit recorded in WO-0004 builder round 3): every file is held to the case count it declares (top-level tm_case lines; a file with a tm_case in a block states '# tm-expect-cases: N'); a shortfall or excess is recorded as a FAILED case (case-count-shortfall/-excess), an underivable count is a harness error; test: t41 reg0015-runner-holds-each-file-to-its-declared-case-count
